description: This file defines structures, constants, and a class (`HdmiInput`) for managing HDMI input ports within a device. It declares methods for querying and configuring HDMI input, such as selecting ports, scaling video, retrieving EDID and HDMI status, and managing audio/video settings.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: Class managing HDMI input ports, providing methods to query ports, select ports, adjust settings, and retrieve HDMI and EDID information.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the HdmiInput class.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI input ports available.

methods.name: HdmiInput::isPresented
methods.description: Checks if HDMI input is currently presented.

methods.name: HdmiInput::isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a specified port is active.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getActivePort
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active HDMI port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::isPortConnected
methods.description: Determines if a specific HDMI port is connected.

methods.name: HdmiInput::selectPort
methods.description: Selects a specific HDMI port, with options for audio and video configuration.

methods.name: HdmiInput::scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video output to specified dimensions.

methods.name: HdmiInput::selectZoomMode
methods.description: Sets the zoom mode for HDMI video.

methods.name: HdmiInput::pauseAudio
methods.description: Pauses HDMI audio.

methods.name: HdmiInput::resumeAudio
methods.description: Resumes HDMI audio.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getCurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Returns the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getCurrentVideoModeObj
methods.description: Retrieves detailed video resolution info.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getEDIDBytesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves EDID bytes for a specific HDMI port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getHDMISPDInfo
methods.description: Gets HDMI SPD (Secondary Program Data) info for a port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getHdmiALLMStatus
methods.description: Gets HDMI ALLM (Auto Low Latency Mode) status.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves supported game-related features.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getAVLatency
methods.description: Gets audio and video latency values.

methods.name: HdmiInput::setEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables EDID 2 Allm support.

methods.name: HdmiInput::getEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Checks if EDID 2 Allm support is enabled.
